subject: Getting Shiny to work with apache passthrough

messages.author: f1c24acf3f7976bb
messages.subject: Getting Shiny to work with apache passthrough
parts:
Hi,

I'm running shiny on Ubuntu 14.04. It works great.

I'm trying to get it to work with the Apache Reverse proxy but am failing to do so. My shiny-server.conf file is:

server {
  listen 3838 127.0.0.1;

  # Define a location at the base URL                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  location / {

    # Host the directory of Shiny Apps stored in this directory                                                                                                                                                                                  
    site_dir /srv/shiny-server;

    # Log all Shiny output to files in this directory                                                                                                                                                                                            
    log_dir /var/log/shiny-server;

    # When a user visits the base URL rather than a particular application,                                                                                                                                                                      
    # an index of the applications available in this directory will be shown.                                                                                                                                                                    
    directory_index on;
  }
}

My /etc/apache2/apache2.conf file has the following added on the bottom:

<VirtualHost *:80>

    ProxyPass / http://127.0.01:3838/
    ProxyPassReverse / http://127.0.0.1:3838/
    ProxyPreserveHost On

</VirtualHost>


However, I can't seem to make a connection. Does the shiny-server.conf file not allow a local address after the port? Any help would be greatly appreciated!

messages.author: f1c24acf3f7976bb
messages.subject: Re: Getting Shiny to work with apache passthrough
parts:
Ok, After much trial and tribulation, I've found the solution. The shiny-server.conf file is correct. However, for Apache in Ubuntu2 , you need to add a file (in my case I called it RshinyPass.conf) to /etc/apache2/sites-available. In it, put:

        Redirect /yourappname /yourappname/
        ProxyPass /yourappname/ http://127.0.0.1:3838/yourappname/
        ProxyPassReverse /yourappname/ http://127.0.0.1:3838/yourappname/

Then do sudo a2ensite RshinyPass.conf
Then sudo service apache2 reload
Then sudo service apache2 restart (for good measure) :-).

Be sure to disable the default 000-default.conf
